sloka: अपापो असि यथा पुत्र निहतः पाप कर्मणा ।तेन सत्येन गच्च आशु ये लोकाः शस्त्र योधिनाम् ॥२-६४-४१॥
transliteration: apāpo asi yathā putra nihataḥ pāpa karmaṇā ।tena satyena gacca āśu ye lokāḥ śastra yodhinām ॥2-64-41॥

translations.english: 'O sinless son, you are killed by a person of sinful deeds. On this truth, quickly go to those worlds which are attained by those valiant heroes.
